storyCards.headline: Gimme The Light: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Sean Paul's "Gimme The Light" reached #7 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Gimme the Light" is the first single from Jamaican dancehall musician Sean Paul's second studio album, Dutty Rock (2002).

The song peaked at #7 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 39 weeks on the chart.

Gimme The Light was released in 2002.
